pose: Vertical orientation, three-quarter view to show the ergonomic curve of the shaft
visual_description: A professional-grade long-handled shovel. The shaft is 48-inches of polished, straight-grain ash wood leading to a heavy-gauge forged steel head. The blade is a deep-dish round point with wide 'foot steps' at the top for driving the shovel into hard earth with a boot. The steel is a matte charcoal color with a silver-polished edge from abrasive use.

constraints.anatomy: Full-length handle (no folding mechanism); oversized deep-dish blade for high-volume debris movement.
constraints.background: Isolated on light grey with a strong contact shadow at the base.
